exposure: culture-based screening for group B streptococcus (GBS) carriage in pregnancy
cohort: Theoretical annual cohort of 711,999 live births in the UK (excluding elective caesarean sections)
finding: This model suggests that adding culture-based GBS screening to a risk-based prevention policy in the UK would likely have a limited impact on reducing EOGBS mortality and severe morbidity, with a high rate of overdetection and overuse of antibiotics.
